name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted BitTorrent indexer that crawls the DHT, classifies content and serves a search web UI, GraphQL API and Torznab endpoint, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: bitmagnet has no login of its own, so the template puts it behind HTTP basic auth: sign in with BITMAGNET_USERNAME and BITMAGNET_PASSWORD from the environment variables. For Prowlarr, Sonarr or Radarr, add a Generic Torznab indexer with the URL https://<domain>/torznab and TORZNAB_API_KEY as its API key; requests without that key need basic auth.

The crawler downloads metadata about torrents found on the public DHT, which can include copyrighted content. Upstream recommends running it behind a VPN; this template connects directly from the server.
